description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = tiny” illustrates how Word Error Rate (WER) changes over training epochs for five fine-tuning/quantization configurations of the Whisper tiny model. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 20 up to 70, with labeled ticks at 30, 40, 50, 60, and 70. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” series is a solid gray line with circular markers, decreasing from about 69 at epoch 0 to about 36 at epoch 6 (with intermediate points near 60 at epoch 1, 55 at epoch 2, 45 at epoch 3, 40 at epoch 4, and 37 at epoch 5). The “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” series is a solid gray line with square markers, moving from about 60 at epoch 0 to about 32 at epoch 6 (approximately 51 at epoch 1, 51 at epoch 2, 43 at epoch 3, 37 at epoch 4, 35 at epoch 5). The “tiny int4” series is a dashed gray line with circular markers, dropping from about 69 at epoch 0 to about 40 at epoch 6 (around 55 at epoch 1, 49 at epoch 2, 44 at epoch 3, 39 at epoch 4, 39 at epoch 5). The “tiny int8” series is a dashed gray line with square markers, decreasing from about 60 at epoch 0 to about 37 at epoch 6 (near 47 at epoch 1, 46 at epoch 2, 43 at epoch 3, 38 at epoch 4, 37 at epoch 5). The “tiny full” series is a dotted gray line with triangle markers, starting near 29 at epoch 0 and ending near 23 at epoch 6 (about 27 at epoch 1, 27 at epoch 2, 24 at epoch 3, 24 at epoch 4, 23.5 at epoch 5).
caption_used: The line plot depicts the Word Error Rate (WER) during fine-tuning of the Whisper 'tiny' model using various weight quantization and adaptation methods across six epochs. The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 6, while the y-axis shows the WER, spanning from 30 to 70. The 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4' method, illustrated by a solid gray line with circular markers, initiates at approximately 70 WER and declines steadily to around 35 by epoch 6. The 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' series, marked by solid squares, starts at roughly 60 WER and stabilizes at 38 by the final epoch. The 'tiny int4' method, shown as a dashed line with circular markers, begins near 70 WER and decreases to 45 by epoch 6, exhibiting a less consistent downward trajectory compared to AdaLoRA variants. The 'tiny int8' approach, represented by dashed squares, commences at 60 WER and collapses to 30 by epoch 6, outperforming all other quantized methods. The 'tiny full' method, indicated by a dotted line with triangular markers, maintains the lowest WER throughout, starting below 30 and gradually declining to approximately 24. Notably, the 'tiny int8' method consistently surpasses the 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' variant after epoch 3, highlighting the efficacy of pure quantization over adaptive low-rank approaches in later training stages.
